cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Power Optimization and Analysis Engineer to join our team.
Our team analyzes fullchip and unit-level power data and works with ASIC teams to improve power efficiency. We also research, develop, and deploy methodologies to help [Company name masked]'s products use less energy. As part of the Power Optimization and Analysis Team, you will collaborate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement power analysis and reduction techniques for [Company name masked]'s next generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Your work will help us gain early insight into energy consumption of graphics and artificial intelligence workloads, and will allow us to influence architectural, design, and power management improvements.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Use internally developed tools and industry standard pre-silicon gate-level and RTL power analysis tools, to help improve product power efficiency. Develop and share best practices for performing pre-silicon power analysis. Perform comparative power analysis, to spot trends and anomalies, that warrant more scrutiny. Interact with architects and RTL designers to help them interpret their power data and identify power bugs; drive them to implement fixes. Select and run a wide variety of workloads for power analysis. Prototype a new architectural feature in Verilog and analyze power.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Recently graduated or will be graduating with a BS or MS (or equivalent experience) with 2+ years of experience or PhD in related fields.
Strong understanding of concepts of energy consumption, estimation, data movement and low power design.
Strong coding/automation skills in Python, Perl, and C++.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles, including knowledge of [Product name masked], [Product name masked].
Desire to bring data-driven decision-making and analytics to improve our products.

Our team analyzes fullchip and unit-level power data and works with ASIC teams to improve power efficiency. We also research, develop, and deploy methodologies to help [Company name masked]'s products use less energy. As part of the Power Optimization and Analysis Team, you will collaborate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement power analysis and reduction techniques for [Company name masked]'s next generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Your work will help us gain early insight into energy consumption of graphics and artificial intelligence workloads, and will allow us to influence architectural, design, and power management improvements.
cond_0037.responsibilities: Use internally developed tools and industry standard pre-silicon gate-level and RTL power analysis tools, to help improve product power efficiency. Develop and share best practices for performing pre-silicon power analysis. Perform comparative power analysis, to spot trends and anomalies, that warrant more scrutiny. Interact with architects and RTL designers to help them interpret their power data and identify power bugs; drive them to implement fixes. Select and run a wide variety of workloads for power analysis. Prototype a new architectural feature in Verilog and analyze power.
cond_0037.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Recently graduated or will be graduating with a BS or MS (or equivalent experience) with 2+ years of experience or PhD in related fields.
Strong understanding of concepts of energy consumption, estimation, data movement and low power design.
Strong coding/automation skills in Python, Perl, and C++.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles, including knowledge of [Product name masked], [Product name masked].
Desire to bring data-driven decision-making and analytics to improve our products.

cond_0222.intro: Our team analyzes fullchip and unit-level power data and works with ASIC teams to improve power efficiency. We also research, develop, and deploy methodologies to help [Company name masked]'s products use energy more efficiently. Key responsibilities include developing techniques to model, analyze, and reduce power consumption of [Company name masked] GPUs. As a member of the Power Optimization and Analysis Team, you will regularly collaborate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement power analysis and reduction techniques for [Company name masked]'s next generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Your work will help us gain early insight into energy consumption of graphics and artificial intelligence workloads, and will allow us to influence architectural, design, and power management improvements.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Use internally developed tools and industry standard pre-silicon gate-level and RTL power analysis tools to help improve product power efficiency.
Develop and share best practices for performing pre-silicon power analysis.
Perform comparative power analysis to spot trends and anomalies that warrant more scrutiny.
Regularly interact with architects and RTL designers to help them interpret their power data and identify power bugs; actively engage with them to drive fixes.
Select and run a wide variety of workloads for power analysis.
Prototype a new architectural feature in Verilog and analyze power.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Recently graduated or will be graduating with a BS or MS (or equivalent experience) with 2+ years of experience, or PhD in a related field.
Strong understanding of energy consumption, estimation, data movement, and low power design.
Strong coding/automation skills in Python, Perl, and/or C++.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles, including knowledge of [Product name masked], [Product name masked].
Desire to bring data-driven decision-making and analytics to improve our products.

We also research, develop, and deploy methodologies to help [Company name masked]'s products use energy more efficiently. As a member of the Power Optimization and Analysis Team, you will coordinate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement power analysis and reduction techniques for [Company name masked]'s next generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles, including knowledge of [Product name masked], [Product name masked].
Desire to apply data-driven decision-making and analytics to improve products.
